messages:
Maya: Quick sync — launching a short copy sprint to get the Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages into a single coherent arc before next week's webinar. Focus: hero clarity, benchmark callouts, and inbound lead routing. Who can demo a first-pass wireframe today?

Jon: I can pull the current drafts into a single doc by EOD. Want to split by audience (devs, platform teams, security) or by deployment mode?

Maya: Split by deployment mode but keep a short shared positioning line (what problem we solve) at the top. Then 2–3 bullets per mode with a one-line cost/latency value prop and an enterprise signal for Private/Dedicated.

Sara: Agree. Proposed shared line: "Predictable, production-grade inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." Keep it simple. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Sam: I like the predictability angle. For Dedicated we should call out SLA + reserved throughput. For Private call out VPC/HSM and audit logs. For Hosted call out rapid onboarding + free credits.

Lucas: Also add a single benchmark blurb under each mode — e.g., Hosted: "<100ms p95 for small models"; Dedicated: "sub-50ms p95 at commit"; Private: "enterprise throughput and isolated KMS" — we can refine numbers later.

Maya: Good. We need concrete language for the hero CTAs and lead routing. Options: 1) Get started (self-serve) 2) Request a capacity consult (dedicated) 3) Talk to sales (private). Need copy that maps to inbound tags in HubSpot.

Jon: Proposed CTAs, short: Hosted -> "Start for free"; Dedicated -> "Reserve capacity"; Private -> "Talk to our team". I can add tracking params: ?src=site_cta_hosted etc.

Sara: For the hero variants, testing idea: swap verbs — "Start for free" vs "Deploy in minutes" for Hosted; measure CTR during webinar landing promotion. Keep A/B matrix small.

Sam: Quick UX note: on the tri-mode page, show 3 columns with 1-line hero, 3 bullets, benchmark tag, and CTA. Mobile collapses to stacked cards. Will ask eng to confirm spacing. @marketing-bot can you add a checklist?

marketing-bot: checklist created: [Wireframes in Figma, Hero copy variants, Benchmark snippets, CTA + tracking, HubSpot tags, Webinar RSVP link]. Link: https://figma.com/redwood/orbit-copy-sprint

Lucas: For benchmark copy, avoid hard claims without validation. Use "typical" or "verified on our catalog" where appropriate: e.g., "Verified p95 on our model catalog." Also a one-sentence method note in footer: "Benchmarks measured on our curated model profiles; your workload may vary."

Maya: Nice call. Action items: Jon — unify drafts + share Figma frames (EOD). Sara — produce 3 hero variants per mode (tomorrow morning). Sam — create CTA routing matrix and HubSpot tag names (tomorrow). Lucas — draft benchmark blurbs and legal-safe phrasing (tomorrow). I'll own final copy pass and sync with growth for webinar promotion.

Jon: On it. Will drop the merged file in #marketing and ping product for quick technical checks.

Sara: If anyone wants to hop on a 20m review at 3pm, I can host.

Sam: I can make 3pm. Lucas can't but will comment in doc.

Maya: Great — 3pm review confirmed. Thanks all :rocket:
